# Setup

```{asis Problems}
There are a few things that worth noticing:  
1. I recoded the symbolism indicator as it shows negative loading in single factor analysis (I recoded 2(deified) to 0 (plain) and 0 to 2). Also, symbolism only has 1400+ data with labeled as 3 (ceremonial).
2. Sovereign seems to be a single vector by itself
3. I also recoded assembly and election since they are related concept. The new indicator called representation has six labels
```

```{r setup, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(haven)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(tidyverse)
    library(mirt)
    library(psych)
    library(scales)
    library(MCMCpack)
    select <- dplyr::select
})

# mirt parallel compute
mirtCluster(4)

# Load datasets
plt_gemini <- read_csv("../data/plt_constraints.csv", show_col_types = F)
# region_broad has the least missingness (n = 16090)
raw_data <- read_csv("../data/plt_dataset.csv", show_col_types = F) %>%
    select(id, region_broad) %>%
    rename(region = region_broad)

plt_gemini <- left_join(plt_gemini, raw_data, by = "id")

# data aggregation
plt_gemini <- plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(
        entry_4_prediction = case_when(
            entry_prediction %in% c(0, 1) ~ 0,
            entry_prediction == 4 ~ 1,
            entry_prediction %in% c(2, 3, 5, 7, 8) ~ 2,
            entry_prediction %in% c(6, 9) ~ 3
        ),
        exit_4_prediction = case_when(
            exit_prediction %in% c(3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13) ~ 0,
            exit_prediction %in% c(5, 6) ~ 1,
            exit_prediction == 0 ~ 2,
            exit_prediction %in% c(1, 2) ~ 3
        ),
        checks_prediction = checks_local_prediction + checks_military_prediction +
            checks_judiciary_prediction + checks_council_prediction +
            checks_bureaucracy_prediction + checks_aristocracy_prediction +
            checks_assembly_prediction + checks_bourgeoisie_prediction +
            checks_clergy_prediction,
        elections_raw_prediction = elections_prediction,
        elections_prediction = if_else(assembly_prediction == 2,
                                       elections_prediction,
                                       NA_real_),
        # 0 - no
        # 1 - council, legislative with no election
        # 2 - assembly with non-competitive election
        # 3 - assembly with election and popular asembly
        representation = case_when(
            assembly_prediction == 0 ~ 0,
            assembly_prediction == 1 ~ 1,
            assembly_prediction == 2 & elections_prediction == 0 ~ 1,
            assembly_prediction == 2 & elections_prediction == 1 ~ 2,
            assembly_prediction == 2 & elections_prediction == 2 ~ 3,
            assembly_prediction == 3 ~ 3),
        # symbolism recode
        symbolism_recode = case_when(
            symbolism_prediction == 2 ~ 0,
            symbolism_prediction == 1 ~ 1,
            symbolism_prediction == 0 ~ 2,
            symbolism_prediction == 3 ~ 3,
        ),
        across(c(exit_prediction, entry_prediction), ~na_if(., 99)))

# Distribution of checks
ggplot(plt_gemini, aes(x=checks_prediction)) +
    geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.7) +
    labs(title = " Aggregated Checks Distribution", x = "Labels", y = "Values") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:9) +
    geom_text(aes(label = after_stat(count)),
              stat = "count",
              vjust = -0.3,
              size = 4) + 
    theme_bw()

# Distribution of representation
ggplot(plt_gemini, aes(x=factor(representation))) +
    geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Representation Distribution", x = "Labels", y = "Values") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("0" = "No Assembly",
                                "1" = "Council",
                                "2" = "Legislature, no elections",
                                "3" = "Non-competitive Legislature",
                                "4" = "Competitive Legislature",
                                "5" = "Popular assembly")) +
    geom_text(aes(label = after_stat(count)),
              stat = "count",
              hjust = -0.3,
              size = 4) +
    theme_bw() +
    coord_flip() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) 

# checks_prediction is sparse after 7 (8: n = 189 (0.14%), 9: n = 33 (0.02%))
# combine 7/8/9 to "7+" (1,274 in total)
plt_gemini <- plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(checks_prediction =  pmin(checks_prediction, 7),
           era = cut(leader_first_year, c(-Inf, 0, 1500, 1800, Inf),
                     labels = c("BC","0-1500","1500-1800","1800-")))

# See the facial validity looks like for entry indicator with four lables
entry_table <- plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(
        total_score = rowSums(select(., sovereign_prediction, constitution_prediction,  
                                     federalism_prediction, 
                                     checks_prediction, collegiality_prediction,
                                     petition_prediction, assembly_prediction,
                                     elections_prediction), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    group_by(entry_4_prediction, era) %>%
    summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_score = mean(total_score, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(entry_4_prediction) & !is.na(era)) %>%
    mutate(display_val = paste0(round(mean_score, 2), " (n=", n, ")")) %>%
    select(entry_4_prediction, era, display_val) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = era, values_from = display_val)

print("---Entry Indicator Table---")
print(entry_table)

# exit
exit_table <- plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(
        total_score = rowSums(select(., sovereign_prediction, constitution_prediction, 
                                     federalism_prediction, checks_prediction, 
                                     collegiality_prediction, petition_prediction, 
                                     assembly_prediction, elections_prediction), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    group_by(exit_4_prediction, era) %>%
    summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_score = mean(total_score, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(exit_4_prediction) & !is.na(era)) %>%
    mutate(display_val = paste0(round(mean_score, 2), " (n=", n, ")")) %>%
    select(exit_4_prediction, era, display_val) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = era, values_from = display_val)

print("---Exit Indicator Table---")
print(exit_table)

# missingness (we only allow entry and exit indicator to have NA)
miss_table <- plt_gemini %>%
    group_by(region, era) %>% 
    summarise(
        n = n(),
        miss_entry_rate = mean(is.na(entry_4_prediction)), 
        miss_exit_rate = mean(is.na(exit_4_prediction)),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(region) & !is.na(era)) %>%
    mutate(display_val = paste0(
        percent(miss_entry_rate, accuracy = 0.1), " / ", 
        percent(miss_exit_rate, accuracy = 0.1), " (n=", n, ")"
    )) %>%
    select(region, era, display_val) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = era, values_from = display_val)

print("--- Combined Missingness Table (Entry % / Exit % (n=Total)) ---")
print(miss_table)

# Seems like there's a chronological missingness


# total score
summary_df <- plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(
        total_score = rowSums(select(., sovereign_prediction, constitution_prediction, 
                                     federalism_prediction, checks_prediction, 
                                     collegiality_prediction, petition_prediction, 
                                     assembly_prediction, elections_prediction), 
                              na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    group_by(era, region) %>%
    summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_score = mean(total_score, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(era) & !is.na(region))

table_df <- summary_df %>%
    mutate(display_val = paste0(round(mean_score, 2), " (n=", n, ")")) %>%
    select(region, era, display_val) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = era, values_from = display_val)

print("---Total score table---")
print(table_df)
```

# Factor Analysis

```{r FA}
# single factor
fa1 <- fa(data_items_B, nfactors = 1, fm = "pa")
print(fa1)

fit_fa <- fa(r = data_items_B,
             nfactors = 3,
             scores = "regression",
             rotate = "oblimin") # This is the default method

pc <- psych::polychoric(data_items_B, global = FALSE)

n_eff <- sum(complete.cases(data_items_B))

fa1_poly <- fa(r = pc$rho, nfactors = 1, n.obs = n_eff, fm = "pa")
fa3_poly <- fa(r = pc$rho, nfactors = 3, n.obs = n_eff, fm = "pa", rotate = "oblimin")

# How many factors do we need?
fa.parallel(data_items_B, fa = "fa", cor = "poly")


print(fa1_poly)

print(fa3_poly)
```

# IRT Model

### MCMCpack (would take 5-7 hours)

```{r MCMCpack}
sub <- data_items_B[sample(nrow(data_items_B), 5000), ]
system.time(
    test <- MCMCordfactanal(as.matrix(sub), factors = 1,
                            lambda.constraints = list(representation = list(2, "+")),
                            burnin = 500, mcmc = 1000, thin = 1,
                            store.lambda = TRUE, store.scores = TRUE,
                            tune = 1.2, verbose = 500)
)
```

### Using mirt since emIRT is not applicable this time

```{r IRT}
#===============================================================================
# IRT: item sets
#===============================================================================

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helper: item matrix & itemtype. Mixed with "2PL" and "graded"
# recoded to K-1
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_irt_data <- function(df, items) {
    dat <- df %>% select(all_of(items)) %>% as.data.frame()
    
    for (v in items) {
        x <- dat[[v]]
        lv <- sort(unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
        cat(sprintf("%-32s n_cat=%d  levels=%s  NA=%d (%.1f%%)\n",
                    v, length(lv), paste(lv, collapse = ","),
                    sum(is.na(x)), 100 * mean(is.na(x))))
        dat[[v]] <- match(x, lv) - 1L   # recoded to 0, 1 ... K-1
    }
    dat
}

get_itemtype <- function(dat) {
    vapply(dat, function(x) {
        k <- length(unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
        if (k <= 2) "2PL" else "graded"
    }, character(1))
}

cat("\n===== Version A items =====\n")
dat_A <- make_irt_data(plt_gemini, items_A)
type_A <- get_itemtype(dat_A)

cat("\n===== Version B items =====\n")
dat_B <- make_irt_data(plt_gemini, items_B)
type_B <- get_itemtype(dat_B)

print(type_A)

dat_C  <- make_irt_data(plt_gemini, items_C)
type_C <- get_itemtype(dat_C)


set.seed(42)

mod_A <- mirt(dat_A, model = 1, itemtype = type_A,
              method = "EM", SE = TRUE,
              technical = list(NCYCLES = 2000))

mod_B <- mirt(dat_B, model = 1, itemtype = type_B,
              method = "EM", SE = TRUE,
              technical = list(NCYCLES = 2000))

m1 <- mirt(dat_C, 1, itemtype = type_C, method = "EM", technical = list(NCYCLES = 2000))
m2 <- mirt(dat_B, 2, itemtype = type_B, method = "EM", technical = list(NCYCLES = 2000))
m3 <- mirt(dat_B, 3, itemtype = type_B, method = "EM", technical = list(NCYCLES = 2000))

anova(m1, m2)
anova(m2, m3)

summary(m2, rotate = "oblimin")
summary(m3, rotate = "oblimin")

saveRDS(mod_A, "./mod_A_unidim.rds")
saveRDS(mod_B, "./mod_B_unidim.rds")

#===============================================================================
# Evaluation
#===============================================================================
coef_A <- coef(mod_A, simplify = TRUE, IRTpars = TRUE)$items
coef_B <- coef(mod_B, simplify = TRUE, IRTpars = TRUE)$items

round(coef_A, 3)
round(coef_B, 3)


coef_A %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("item") %>%
    select(item, a) %>%
    arrange(desc(a)) %>%
    print()

summary(mod_A)
summary(mod_B)

plt_gemini %>%
    filter((polity_name == "Soviet Union") & (leader_first_year >= 1924) & (leader_last_year <= 1953)) %>% View()
```

## Facial Validity

```{r Validity test}
# mirtCluster(remove = TRUE)
th1 <- fscores(m1, method = "EAP", full.scores.SE = TRUE)

plt_scored <- plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(theta = th1[, 1], theta_se = th1[, 2],
           n_miss = rowSums(is.na(dat_B)))
# Era
plt_scored %>%
    group_by(era) %>%
    slice_max(theta, n = 10) %>%
    select(era, polity_name, leader_name, leader_first_year, theta, theta_se) %>%
    arrange(era, desc(theta)) %>%
    print(n = 50)

plt_scored %>%
    group_by(era) %>%
    slice_min(theta, n = 10) %>%
    select(era, polity_name, leader_name, leader_first_year, theta, theta_se) %>%
    print(n = 50)

# Polity (It seems like it depends on the length of that polity as well)
plt_scored %>%
    group_by(polity_name) %>%
    filter(n() >= 30) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), theta = mean(theta, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(theta)) %>%
    print(n = 20)


# Known polities
source("classic_cases.R")
# key_cases <- c("Roman Republic","Athens","Venice","England",
#                "Russia","Prussia","Ottoman Empire","China",
#                "Soviet Union","Germany","Japan","France", "United States Of America")
plt_scored %>%
    add_case() %>%
    group_by(case) %>%
    summarise(n          = n(),
              n_leaders  = n_distinct(leader_name),
              theta_mean = mean(theta, na.rm = TRUE),
              theta_sd   = sd(theta, na.rm = TRUE),
              theta_sem  = theta_sd / sqrt(sum(!is.na(theta))),
              eap_se     = mean(theta_se, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups    = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(theta_mean)) %>% print(n = Inf)

ggplot(plt_scored, aes(leader_first_year, theta)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.03) +
    geom_smooth(method = "gam") +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Executive constraints")

th2 <- fscores(m2, method = "EAP") 
plt2 <- plt_scored %>% mutate(f1 = th2[,1], f2 = th2[,2])


case_pts <- plt2 %>% add_case()     

case_ctr <- case_pts %>%
    group_by(case) %>%
    summarise(f1 = mean(f1, na.rm = TRUE),
              f2 = mean(f2, na.rm = TRUE),
              n  = n(), .groups = "drop")   

ggplot(plt2, aes(f1, f2)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.02, colour = "grey40") +                   
    geom_point(data = case_pts, aes(colour = case),                   
               alpha = 0.35, size = 1) +
    geom_point(data = case_ctr, aes(fill = case), shape = 21,   
               size = 3, colour = "black", stroke = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = case_ctr, aes(label = case),
                             size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf,
                             box.padding = 0.4, min.segment.length = 0,
                             seed = 42) +
    guides(colour = "none") +
    labs(x = "F1", y = "F2") +
    theme_minimal()


# library(mgcv)
# 
dd <- plt_scored %>%
    filter(!is.na(theta), !is.na(leader_first_year),
           !is.na(region), !is.na(polity_name)) %>%
    mutate(polity_name = factor(polity_name),
           region      = factor(region))

dd2 <- dd %>%
    group_by(polity_name) %>%
    filter(n() >= 5) %>%
    mutate(theta_c = theta - mean(theta)) %>%
    ungroup()

m_fe <- bam(theta_c ~ s(leader_first_year, k = 30), data = dd2, discrete = TRUE)
plot(m_fe, shade = TRUE)


m_reg <- bam(theta_c ~ region + s(leader_first_year, by = region, k = 25),
            data = dd2, discrete = TRUE, nthreads = 4)

plot(m_reg, select = 1, shade = TRUE)

plt_gemini %>% filter(polity_name == "Roman Republic") %>%
    count(cut(leader_first_year, seq(-510, -20, by = 50))) %>% print(n = 20)
```
